name: Dr. Trupti Gokani
reason: Re-checked 12 Nov 2026 (truptigokanimd.com home): her own site still presents her first as a board-certified neurologist and health and mindset coach, and its paid courses and downloads are condition-led: the Headache Reset Course, the Gut Reboot Course, '7 Simple Rules to Resolve Chronic Headaches', '10 Key Lifestyle and Dietary Tips to Rid Yourself of Headaches' and 'Lose Weight and Feel Great' (diet). What would pass (stress-reduction and NLP mindset coaching, a dosha quiz) is coaching rather than spiritual practice and too thin for a listing; her work is mainly condition treatment and diet.
